name: Bitfab
description: Trace inspection, failure diagnosis, and replay-driven iteration for AI-powered code. Instrument your LLM calls, build regression datasets, and measure improvements — all inside Claude Code.
longDescription:
Ships **3 commands**, **1 hook** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Commands** (3): `improve` (Iterate on a traced function to improve pass rates using failed traces, labeling, and replay), `setup` (Set up Bitfab tracing — authenticate, instrument, and create replay scripts), `update` (Update Bitfab plugin to the latest version)
- **Hooks** (1): `SessionStart`
- **MCP servers** (1): `Bitfab`

Installs with `claude plugin install bitfab@claude-community` from `Project-White-Rabbit/bitfab-claude-plugin`.
